Before reporting a hardware fault, please attempt these troubleshooting steps: perform a full restart, ensure the laptop is plugged in with the company charger and the charging light is on, and install any pending updates [S1]. If the screen is frozen, hold the power button for 10 seconds, wait, and switch it back on [S1].

If the laptop still does not switch on, you should raise a hardware fault ticket [S2]. Please include the asset tag (found on the bottom of the laptop starting with `AT-`), the laptop model, and a description of what happens and when the issue started [S2].

If the battery is swollen, very hot, smoking, or leaking, stop using the laptop immediately and follow the Laptop Battery Safety policy [S2]. If you observe these warning signs, unplug the charger if safe to do so, move the device to a hard, non-flammable surface, and do not cover it [S4]. Report this immediately by raising an urgent hardware ticket or calling the Service Desk at extension 5555 [S5].
